## LocalAsrCapabilities.streaming property

True if the runtime emits partials mid-utterance. v1 is false — whisper.cpp is batch; Moss presents a streaming-shaped session by emitting one final per VAD-committed utterance.

**Signature:**

```typescript
streaming: boolean;
```
